versions.changelog: Initial release. Drafts an ICH E6(R3) / ICH M11 CeSHaRP–aligned clinical-trial protocol synopsis from an investigator concept or sponsor TPP, with PICOT framing, ICH E9(R1) estimand tables, sample-size and statistical-considerations block, key inclusion / exclusion criteria, schedule-of-assessments outline, safety reporting plan, and regulatory / ethics flags for sponsor and IRB / IEC review.
